messages:
maya: heads-up: auto-fallback kicked in on /embed/v1 for ~25s. only a short 502 burst but route went into hard-degrade and paged on-call :grimacing:

jon: yikes. do we still have the max-of combinator that instantly escalates when kv_miss+5xx align?

maya: yes, and that seems to be the culprit. short duration but high kv_miss ratio bumped the combined score over the hard threshold.

ritesh: suggestion: switch to weighted-sum with a noise-floor and require either duration >= 45s OR sustained avg across 2 windows. also add spike_guard to ignore single-window spikes unless very large.

lia: console UX: show the exact compact decision blob inline (policy id, score, top contributors) so on-call doesn't guess what "combined" means. small human line too: "why: 5xx spike + kv_miss".

samir: audit retention: keep compact blobs in the main audit log, store full samples in sampled-store (0.5% default, always sample degraded requests). on-call can request an elevated fetch token valid for 10m.

maya: API ask: decision service expose `/v1/decision?route=/embed/v1&window=30s` returning a flat semicolon string like: `policy=soft_v3;decision=degrade;score=0.78;hysteresis_left=22`. no nested JSON so console parsing is trivial.

ops-bot: note: paging suppression enabled for routes <100rps to reduce noise.

lia: inbox change: group degrade events per route into one thread, show counts + timeline and add snooze (5m/30m/1h) that annotates audit rows. include RBAC: only SREs can force-revert.

jon: also add oscillation protection: if flips >3 in 10m, increase hysteresis multiplier to avoid thrash.

maya: action items: ritesh -> PR for weighted-sum + spike_guard; jon -> spec flat decision blob and SDK parse helper; lia -> inbox grouping mock + RBAC; samir -> sampling/cost table. i'll write a 4-line runbook for on-call. thanks all :thumbsup:
